title: White House rolls out voluntary pre-release testing framework for frontier models
summary: The administration finalized a voluntary framework for labs to submit closed frontier models for government safety testing up to 30 days before release; open-weight models are excluded.
reason: New government eval regime, though voluntary and unpublished.

title: Alibaba releases Qwen3.8-Max and pledges open weights
summary: Alibaba made Qwen3.8-Max widely available, claiming it rivals OpenAI, Anthropic and Kimi K3, and said it will publish the weights.
reason: Self-reported frontier-class Chinese model; weights only promised.

title: Texas freezes new data-center approvals pending grid audit
summary: Governor Greg Abbott halted approval of new data-center projects until an audit of their grid connections. Date uncertain: Texas Tribune report dated Aug 3; Wikipedia lists Aug 10.
reason: Large US state pauses AI infrastructure.
